developer-mac.description: The maintainer's M-series MacBook, the window on its 1x display at 100 Hz (ticks 10 ms apart, so a smooth 60 frames/s alternates 10 and 20 ms between new frames).
developer-mac.why: Set on 2026-10-18 from five rounds of every scenario: frames/s at least the slowest round less 2; late frames at most the worst round plus 2.5 points; the 99th-percentile frame interval at most one display tick (10 ms) beyond the worst round; CPU per frame (the analysis thread, the main thread, which in a host is its own UI thread, WebKit, and their total) at most 1.5 times the worst round, as it varied by up to a third between rounds. The worst case does not hold 60 frames/s on this machine yet (36 to 51 frames/s, 19 to 32% of frames late, 11 to 19 ms of analysis per frame): its limits keep it from getting worse, not from being slow, until it is made smooth.
